independence_declaration.statement: I am qa-verifier. I did not author any analysis, register, agent definition, runner, guard, gate tooling, CI or delivery record in the reviewed scope. I wrote only QA tests and logs under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/ and my own round-26 review files. During my run the domain-reviewer's and code-security-reviewer's round-26 run evidence was auto-committed (46aebd7, a6fc577). It was metadata only and the candidate ID did not change. I read only aggregate role, model_requested and session fields across all DG0 run meta.json files, to check distinct invocations. I did not open their records, sidecars, narratives or evidence. My disposable clones were taken at 2f480e4, before those commits. I formed this verdict before any other round-26 conclusion was visible to me.

checks_run.expected: Anchor 1 is unconditional (an absent round source_commit rejects the closure); comments and D-042 state the guarantee accurately; no new tolerance
checks_run.actual: checkClosure now pushes 'verified in <round>, whose frozen candidate source_commit ... is not present; a closure must be verified against a retained candidate (F-DG0-169)' when commitPresent(round.source_commit) is false, and otherwise checks ancestry. commitPresent uses '<sha>^{commit}', so present non-commit objects are rejected too (confirmed by QA26-N3). The round source_commit is additionally schema-constrained to 40-hex. The header comment and D-042 describe this accurately. The only remaining absence tolerance is findManifest's content-preserving one, and it no longer lets a closure be verified (QA26-N4 shows it stays closure-scoped). No new residual is introduced relative to threat-model.md.

summary: PASS on candidate 7ac71190 (7edacdc). No new findings, and none of mine were open; F-DG0-169 is code-security's to close. D-042 is verified independently. The round-25 case (a forged-absent round with a candidate-scope or non-candidate fix after the claimed freeze and before the run) is ACCEPTED on the pre-D-042 baseline and REJECTED on the candidate by the F-DG0-169 error alone. There is no absence escape, even for an otherwise perfect fix, and present non-commit objects are rejected. The rejection is closure-scoped. The standing controls hold. The full-history dry-run has 0 PRUNED/RECORD-LESS/DROPPED errors and 0 closure-anchor errors, and all 115 real closures pass all three anchors. Pre-freeze 11/11, register 0 errors, agents 10/10, live guard blocks, A01-A28 feasible.
